name: Kristi Rietz
occupation: Platte County treasurer (serving through the current term, which ends in January 2027)

background: Kristi Rietz is the Platte County treasurer, serving through the end of the current term in January 2027. She won the November 2022 general election, and the official treasurer page lists her in that office. Incoming treasurer Lisa Glover takes office in January 2027.
